label: MC-003
note: Reachable null-guard deleted: the ArgumentNullException guard on request.Customer was the only protection before Customer.Id is dereferenced; callers can pass null legally (nullable reference type), so removing the guard introduces a real NRE regression. Bar is MEDIUM, not HIGH: the input already threw before this change, so what regresses is the exception TYPE and message quality, not success-to-failure — unlike MC-001, where an always-null navigation property turns a working path into an unconditional throw.
